title: Construct static null distributions

prePopulationAmendment.trigger: The first uniformity-only validation, before any population replay or null-corpus generation, showed that a fixed total-variation cutoff of 0.01 is below ordinary multinomial fluctuation for 210 support points at 210,000 draws. The fixture otherwise had full support, zero preservation violations, and chi-square p=0.232068.
prePopulationAmendment.change: Replace the fixed TV<=0.01 rule by a support-size-aware bound TV<=max(0.01, 2*sqrt((supportSize-1)/(2*pi*draws))).
prePopulationAmendment.unchanged: Null hypotheses, sufficient statistics, populations, seeds, draw counts, metrics, inference, success gates, and all other validation rules.

question: At fixed accepted-swap progress points, do observed policy-label arrangements exceed valid static label-permutation distributions after fixing exact composition, and how does inference change when policy-value association is also fixed?

nullHypotheses.role: unconditional with respect to policy-value association
nullHypotheses.exchangeability: Uniformly permute policy labels over all fixed position indices.
preserves: open-path position coordinate and adjacency graph
the observed value at every position
the exact global count of every policy label
array length and all non-label state components
doesNotPreserve: policy label at its observed position
nullHypotheses.hypothesis: Conditional on the fixed scaffold and exact global counts, every distinct global policy-label arrangement is equally likely.
nullHypotheses.interpretation: Tests total static policy-label structure, including structure mediated by policy-value association.

nullHypotheses.exchangeability: Uniformly and independently permute policy labels within prespecified value strata while leaving the fixed position/value scaffold unchanged.

strata.repeated_1_10_x10: exact numeric value; ten strata of size ten
strata.unique_1_100: fixed numeric value deciles 1-10, 11-20, ..., 91-100; ten strata of size ten

preserves: all sufficient statistics preserved by global_count_fixed
the exact policy-by-exact-value contingency for repeated inputs
the exact policy-by-value-decile contingency for unique inputs
doesNotPreserve: policy label at its observed position within a stratum
nullHypotheses.hypothesis: Conditional on the fixed scaffold and exact policy counts within every frozen value stratum, every distinct within-stratum policy-label arrangement is equally likely.
nullHypotheses.interpretation: Tests spatial structure beyond the frozen resolution of policy-value association; it can remove a real policy-mediated mechanism and is not automatically the preferred null.

nullHypotheses.exchangeability: For unique values, permute labels only among positions carrying the identical numeric value.
nullHypotheses.hypothesis: No nontrivial exchangeability remains because every value stratum is a singleton.
nullHypotheses.interpretation: No p-value is defined; reporting the degeneracy guards against over-conditioning away the entire mechanism.

metrics.upperTailDirection: larger values indicate stronger homotypic clustering for every reported metric

excluded.mean_run_length: algebraically redundant with adjacency on the open path
excluded.neighbor_nmi: unsigned and therefore also rewards alternation
excluded.equal_value_corrected_excess_on_unique_i: structurally undefined because there are no equal-value adjacent edges

sampling.distinctArrangementRule: Permute labeled positions uniformly; because each distinct multiset arrangement has the same product of label-count factorial preimages, induced distinct label arrangements are uniform.

inference.observedUnitFullPointwise: condition mean over all 250 paired scenarios at each of 101 fixed grid points
inference.observedUnitConditionalAudit: condition mean over the frozen 25-scenario subset at each of five fixed grid points
inference.pValue: one-sided conservative Monte Carlo p=(1+number of null statistics greater than or equal to observed)/(B+1)
inference.calibrationPValue: randomized upper-tail p=(number strictly greater + U*(number tied + 1))/(B+1), with independent U, used only for false-positive calibration
inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values within each grid point, metric, and null family across the 186 conditions
inference.pointwiseBoundary: No maximum, earliest crossing, duration, area above threshold, or ever-significant statistic is a confirmatory S05 result; those trajectory-level questions belong to S06.
inference.conditioningComparison: Report paired changes in null means, standardized deviations, p-values, q-values, and the count of global-significant results that do or do not remain significant under value-stratum conditioning.

validation.s04Integrity: The canonical S04 table must exist, have 75,335,939 bytes, and match SHA-256 97ce5985d9dc9b666f8c16345a2c678535037c53ad58867fc8305c975e6db647; the S04 manifest entry must agree.
validation.snapshotReplay: Every frozen snapshot scenario must match S03/S04 scenario identity, terminal reason, accepted swaps, final state hash, and original trajectory hash; captured metrics must match the canonical S04 row at each selected grid point.
uniformityFixtures: two value strata of size three with counts 2/1 in each (9 distinct conditional arrangements)
six unique singleton exact-value strata (one arrangement; degeneracy check)
validation.uniformityPassRule: Every support point observed; chi-square p greater than 0.0001 for each nondegenerate fixture; total-variation distance at most max(0.01, 2*sqrt((supportSize-1)/(2*pi*draws))); exact support accounting matches multinomial products.
validation.preservationPassRule: Zero global-count, stratum-count, position-scaffold, or value-scaffold violations across all generated draws and replayed snapshots.
validation.globalFalsePositivePassRule: For alpha 0.01, 0.05, and 0.10, each randomized empirical rate is within max(5 binomial SE, 0.002) of alpha and each conservative rate is no greater than alpha plus that tolerance.
validation.conditionalFalsePositivePassRule: Pooling independently randomized pseudo-observations across condition-grid groups by input and estimable metric, each rate is within max(5 binomial SE, 0.01) of alpha at 0.01, 0.05, and 0.10.
validation.upstreamImmutability: Every S01-S04 manifested artifact remains byte-identical; S04 table availability and checksum are recorded separately from any external collection-skip metadata.

successCriteria.execution: All frozen corpora, 18,786 full pointwise condition-grid rows, 930 conditional condition-grid groups, snapshot replays, and required reports validate.
successCriteria.calibration: Uniformity, preservation, and both global and conditional false-positive checks pass.
successCriteria.primaryAdjacency: At fixed progress 25%, at least four of the six balanced pairwise absent-association input-by-policy conditions have global-count-fixed adjacency q<=0.05; at fixed progress 100%, at least 12 of 16 balanced positive/negative association conditions have global-count-fixed adjacency q<=0.05.
successCriteria.metricCorroboration: At least two of categorical assortativity, largest-label capture, and signed neighbor NMI meet the same 12-of-16 fixed-final association threshold.
successCriteria.conditioningDescriptor: Classify the result as conditioning-sensitive if at least 25% of globally significant conditional-audit tests become nonsignificant under value-stratum conditioning; otherwise classify it as conditioning-robust. This descriptor does not override calibration or the primary classification.
successCriteria.classification: Supportive if execution, calibration, primary adjacency, and metric corroboration pass; constraining/contradictory if execution and calibration pass but either scientific gate fails or conditioning removes most apparent signal; null if calibrated tests yield no usable pointwise signal.

claimBoundary: These are static randomization tests for computational label arrangements at prespecified fixed progress points. They do not establish a dynamic null, correct maxima over time, identify causality, demonstrate attraction or restoration, or support biological claims.
